messages:
Ava: quick heads-up — pasted a small mock for the batch vectors preview: https://figma.redwood/example.png :eyes:
Tom: nice, looks cleaner. quick q: why is the Export CTA sitting on the left of the toolbar? Feels pretty prominent
Ava: legacy pattern — Export has been left-aligned historically. I'm starting to worry about accidental exports on large selections though
Sam: +1 to moving Export into the kebab menu. The primary should be Run/Preview or Create rerank set, not Export
Riley: accessibility nits: contrast on that blue Export button fails AA at smaller sizes. Also keyboard order currently tabs Export -> Row select -> Run which feels backwards
Kai: engineering perspective: making Run primary makes sense. We can wire Export into async flow and surface it in the overflow. Also we can show estimated file size before kicking off export
Ava: proposed change: move Export to overflow, make 'Preview rerank' the primary action (solid), keep a secondary 'Save selection' if needed. Add `aria-live` regions for preview progress
Maya (PM): timeline question — can we land this for the sprint demo next Wed? It's a big UX blocker for external previews
Sam: I'll prototype two variants today: A) Export in menu + Run primary; B) Export as secondary but with confirm modal. Will push frames by EOD
Riley: for screen readers: don't rely on color to indicate relevance. Add textual SR hints like `aria-label="relevance: high/medium/low"` and a visually hidden label for the gradient. Also ensure focus ring is visible on row chips
Tom: copy nit: 'Download vectors' => 'Export vectors (.csv)' makes the action clearer. Also consider 'Export selected' vs 'Export all' toggle in the modal
Ava: good catch on copy. I'll update the wording and mock a filesize estimate in the export modal. Might also show a sample of the CSV header
Kai: FYI: export will enqueue a job in our worker system. We can emit progress events and a toast when ready. That should mitigate accidental long waits
Maya (PM): consensus forming: move Export to overflow, make Run primary, fix focus order, add SR labels and filesize preview. Put the confirm/export options behind the menu so accidental clicks are less likely
Sam: I'll include keyboard-only flows and add a short screencast for the accessibility review
Riley: please add test cases for NVDA/JAWS reading order + keyboard-only selection + focus loop when modal closes
Ava: I'll update the Figma frames and the accessibility checklist, then tag everyone here when done :slightly_smiling_face:
Sam: upload incoming — will ping when it's ready
Ava: thanks all — great feedback, especially on the SR labels and file-size preview. Closing loop for now
